record.question: Which committee is responsible for proposals of introducing new forms, discontinuing form and revising existing forms?
record.explanation: Answer C: Medical Record Committee. A medical record committee commonly reviews and recommends creation, revision, and discontinuation of standardized forms. Reference: https://regulations.justia.com/states/oklahoma/title-310/chapter-667/subchapter-9/section-310-667-9-13/; https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/208125/9290610050_rev_eng.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
